title: Trip Planner (Flawed)
subtitle: Missing auth (TC-001) & sensitive leak (TC-003)
spec:
resource User:
  fields:
    id: uuid
    email: string
    password_hash: string [sensitive]

resource Trip:
  fields:
    id: uuid
    destination: string
    owner_id: uuid -> User.id

secrets:
  DB_URL: env
  JWT_SECRET: env

endpoint POST /trips:
  resource: Trip
  auth: required
  body: [destination]
  returns: Trip

endpoint GET /trips/{id}:
  resource: Trip
  returns: Trip

endpoint GET /users/{id}:
  resource: User
  auth: required
  returns: User

title: Trip Planner (Owner-protected)
subtitle: Owner-protected Trip access and self-only User access
spec:
resource User:
  fields:
    id: uuid
    email: string
    password_hash: string [sensitive]

resource Trip:
  fields:
    id: uuid
    destination: string
    owner_id: uuid -> User.id

secrets:
  DB_URL: env
  JWT_SECRET: env

endpoint POST /trips:
  resource: Trip
  auth: required
  body: [destination]
  returns: Trip

endpoint GET /trips/{id}:
  resource: Trip
  auth: required
  returns: Trip

endpoint GET /users/{id}:
  resource: User
  auth: required
  returns: User [id, email]

title: Trip Planner (Ownership Waiver)
subtitle: Explicit waiver on PUT /trips/{id}/visibility
spec:
resource User:
  fields:
    id: uuid
    email: string
    password_hash: string [sensitive]

resource Trip:
  fields:
    id: uuid
    destination: string
    owner_id: uuid -> User.id
    is_public: bool

secrets:
  DB_URL: env
  JWT_SECRET: env

endpoint POST /trips:
  resource: Trip
  auth: required
  body: [destination]
  returns: Trip

endpoint GET /trips/{id}:
  resource: Trip
  auth: required
  returns: Trip

endpoint GET /users/{id}:
  resource: User
  auth: required
  returns: User [id, email]

endpoint PUT /trips/{id}/visibility:
  resource: Trip
  auth: required
  authorize: public
  body: [is_public]
